name: Archival Documentary Reconstruction
description: Period-photographic historical reconstructions with restrained sepia monochrome, authentic materials, and aged documentary atmosphere.
style_bible: original archival documentary photographic reconstruction, historically plausible people environments objects maps newspapers offices streets institutions and industry, candid observational staging rather than theatrical posing, warm charcoal-sepia monochrome, restrained contrast with softly lifted highlights and deep but readable blacks, authentic period clothing architecture materials and technology, natural lens falloff, subtle silver-gelatin emulsion grain, faint dust and occasional hairline scratches, gently uneven exposure, soft vignette, modest depth of field, documentary evidence-room atmosphere, convincing early photographic texture while remaining an explicitly created reconstruction rather than a claimed recovered source
negative_prompt: modern objects, contemporary clothing, glossy colour photography, vivid saturation, cinematic blockbuster lighting, polished CGI, painterly illustration, ink wash, cartoon, copied historical photograph, famous-person likeness unless explicitly requested, fabricated readable newspaper claims, propaganda poster styling, subtitles, captions, labels, logos, watermark, player UI, borders, letterbox bars, extreme film damage that obscures the subject
